description: After the person has swapped cards with this booth (booth_connect), claims the booth's swag drop into their own Swag Bag. Pass `eventId` and `boothId` as booth_connect was given them. Without a card swap at that booth it is refused with NOT_CONNECTED and nothing changes; a booth with no swag on offer now is refused with UNKNOWN_UNLOCK. Swag already in their bag is not claimed twice: the reply says already. Returns ok, the drop's `id`, `done` and a sentence for the person. Needs a personal connector token. It works in two steps: a call with no `confirm` returns a `confirmToken` and changes nothing; a call with confirm true and that token applies it.

boothId.description: The booth id, as booth_connect was given it.

confirm.description: Absent on the first call, which changes nothing. true, together with confirmToken, applies it.

confirmToken.description: The token the first call returned. Needed when confirm is true.

eventId.description: The event id or public slug the booth is at.

name: booth_claim_swag
title: Claim a booth's swag
